crossRefs.note: Moreover in Jerusalem Jehoshaphat appointed Levites and priests, and of the heads of the fathers’ households of Israel…
You shall make judges and officers in all your gates, which Yahweh your God gives you, according to your tribes; and…
Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who…
Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;
or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

translations.web: He set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,
translations.bsb: He appointed judges in the land, in each of the fortified cities of Judah.
translations.kjv: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fenced cities of Judah, city by city,
translations.asv: And he set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Judah, city by city,
